blocks.title: Instantaneous aur average rate
blocks.text: Kisi muddat ke dauran kisi ek lamhe ki rate instantaneous (lamhati) rate hai. Reaction ki average (ausat) rate do makhsoos waqton ke darmiyan ki rate hai, ek muddat par rate.
Average aur instantaneous rates kisi bhi muddat mein sirf ek lamhe par barabar hoti hain: pehle instantaneous rate average se zyada hai, aur muddat ke aakhir mein kam.

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 7.1: Haber process mein ammonia, N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3
rows: 1.0 min ke baad instantaneous rate (print ke mutabiq delta C = 2.7 mol dm-3 1 min mein)
1.0 aur 4.0 min ke darmiyan average rate, [NH3] 3.5 phir 6.2 mol dm-3

blocks.prompt: Reaction ke dauran instantaneous rate kyun badalti hai, aur yeh average rate ke barabar kab hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Rate reactants ki concentrations par munhasir hai, jo kharch hone ke saath musalsal girti hain, to curve ki dhalwan, instantaneous rate, lamha ba lamha girti hai. Kisi bhi muddat mein yeh average se oopar shuru ho kar us se neeche khatam hoti hai, darmiyan mein theek ek lamhe par average se milti hui.

items: Instantaneous rate: ek lamhe ki dhalwan; average rate: muddat par tabdeeli (Haber sample: 3.0 min mein 2.7 mol dm-3 = 0.90 mol dm-3 min-1); yeh sirf ek lamhe par milti hain.
